subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: What permanent core contract should own subagent lifecycle receipts and public supervision actions for this issue?
rationale: Current main has partial task, audit, artifact, and internal control building blocks, but exposing ordered receipts and cancel/steer/resume actions is a public Gateway/runtime contract with security and compatibility implications.

options.title: Extend task and audit ledgers
options.body: Make the existing task ledger the durable lifecycle receipt and audit supervision actions through the existing metadata-only audit surface, adding protocol fields and tests around redaction and idempotency.

options.title: Add a new Gateway lifecycle stream
options.body: Create a separate public lifecycle event surface when maintainers want ordered receipts independent of task summaries, accepting the extra protocol and storage ownership.

options.title: Keep current surfaces only
options.body: Decline the broader contract and close or narrow this issue to existing task list/get/cancel behavior plus targeted channel-specific follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Extend task and audit ledgers
recommendation.body: Make the existing task ledger the durable lifecycle receipt and audit supervision actions through the existing metadata-only audit surface, adding protocol fields and tests around redaction and idempotency.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history on the task registry/runtime delivery seam that would likely own the canonical ledger extension.
